completed_scope: Complete bounded tag/referrer source page walks support one unambiguous next relation, quoted/URI commas, opaque exact-resource origin cursors and approved signed delivery links with isolated source credentials.
Every page passes common address/network/query/hop limits; cycles, ambiguity, entry/graph/metadata/page exhaustion and later-page failures cannot publish a partial catalog or graph.
Catalog refresh walks metadata unconditionally because a first-page validator cannot establish an unchanged complete collection. Manifest/blob conditional revalidation remains.

Native tags/referrers support n and exclusive last, current-policy filtering, relative next links, artifact-type filter context, HEAD, page ETags, zero/end pages and strict malformed/duplicate argument rejection.

Referrers API 404 uses the legacy sha256-subject tag index. Missing fallback is empty; authorization errors do not trigger fallback. Actual referents/known subjects still govern policy, including empty pages.
Graph checks are shared within a source discovery view. Resource exhaustion returns an explicit metadata-limit error rather than silently omitting candidates as policy-denied.

Stock ORAS and real PostgreSQL exercise source and native pages, fallback negatives, current subject/referrer denial, atomic later-page rejection and absence of ephemeral cursors/credentials in durable tenant data.
All earlier native clients and the real pinned Docker Hub/token/CloudFront journey replayed against the same exact clean binaries.
